visual_action: A static image of a line graph titled "S&P 500 INDEXED TO INAUGURATION DAY". The graph plots the performance of the S&P 500 index over the first 100 days of three presidential terms. Lines for "Obama - 2013" and "Biden - 2021" show positive growth, trending upwards. A red line for a hypothetical "Trump - 2025" shows a steep decline, dropping to -10%. Circular photos of each president are placed near the end of their respective lines on the graph.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: A line on the graph is labeled "Trump - 2025" and shows a projected steep decline in the S&P 500. A photo of him appears on the graph.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: A line on the graph is labeled "Biden - 2021" and is used as a point of comparison. A photo of him appears on the graph.

cast.name: Barack Obama
cast.evidence: A line on the graph is labeled "Obama - 2013" and is used as a point of comparison. A photo of him appears on the graph.

spoken_summary: An unidentified male voiceover states, "He promised to lower your grocery prices."
audio_music: The video consists of a single line of spoken dialogue with no accompanying music or significant sound effects.
manipulation_or_satire: The graph is a fabricated document that presents a hypothetical, future stock market performance for "Trump - 2025" as if it were factual, historical data. This fabricated data line is plotted alongside real historical data for Obama and Biden to create a misleading visual comparison.
central_claim: A future Donald Trump presidency in 2025 would cause a stock market crash, unlike the economic growth experienced under Democratic presidents Joe Biden and Barack Obama.
intended_effect: To create fear about the potential economic consequences of a Trump presidency and persuade viewers to vote against him.
uncertainty_flags: The source of the graph and its data is not cited.
